items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: And I played with Papa Celestine, about eight years, three and second trumpet.

ctx.x: after that, I think in 1938, 39, then I went to Papa Celestine. Uh-huh.
As a trumpet player? Yeah. As a trumpet player? Yeah. Mm-hmm. You given up playing drums altogether?
